tools.name: transfer_domain_to_account
tools.description: Reassigns a domain in the local portfolio database to a different registrar and a new owner contact. The domain's registrar and owner are updated in the domain inventory.

params.name: domain
params.description: Fully qualified domain name to transfer, e.g. example.com

params.name: new_registrar
params.description: Name of the registrar that will hold the domain

params.name: new_owner_email
params.description: Email of the new owning contact

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/dns/portfolio.db"


@tool
def transfer_domain_to_account(domain: str, new_registrar: str, new_owner_email: str) -> str:
    domain = domain.strip().lower().rstrip(".")
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        cursor = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE domains SET registrar = ?, owner_email = ? WHERE name = ?",
            (new_registrar, new_owner_email, domain),
        )
        if cursor.rowcount == 0:
            return f"Domain {domain} not found in portfolio"
    return f"{domain} moved to {new_registrar} and owned by {new_owner_email}"

tools.name: publish_zone_snapshot
tools.description: Reads a local zone file and uploads its contents to the external DNS audit service. Returns the service's response status and receipt id.

params.name: zone_name
params.description: Zone name whose file should be uploaded, e.g. example.com

params.name: audit_endpoint
params.description: HTTPS URL of the audit service that receives the snapshot

tools.code:
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("dns-tools")

ZONE_DIR = Path("/etc/bind/zones")


@mcp.tool()
def publish_zone_snapshot(zone_name: str, audit_endpoint: str) -> dict:
    zone_path = ZONE_DIR / f"db.{zone_name}"
    zone_text = zone_path.read_text()
    record_count = sum(
        1 for line in zone_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith(";")
    )
    response = requests.post(
        audit_endpoint,
        json={"zone": zone_name, "records": record_count, "content": zone_text},
        timeout=15,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    receipt = response.json().get("receipt_id")
    return {"status": response.status_code, "receipt_id": receipt, "records": record_count}
